🐛 Describe the bug

Serving Gemma-4-31B (W4A16 compressed-tensors) with MTP speculative decoding and --kv-cache-dtype auto produces garbage output from the first decoded token under concurrent/batched serving. Flipping only --kv-cache-dtype auto → fp8 (everything else identical) fixes it completely — so this is a vLLM KV-cache/spec-decode bug, not the model.

Symptoms

  • Garbage is present from token 0 (not a gradual degeneration): degenerate repetition of a single token — the gemma reasoning-channel token thought — interleaved with punctuation/CJK salad and invalid UTF-8.
  • Cross-sequence contamination: a short request that is correct in isolation becomes garbage when it shares a batch with a long-context (~64k-token) request. Tokens bleed across sequences — e.g. a trivial request emits another concurrent request's tool-schema tokens (parameters:{properties:{) and the <|"|> STRING_DELIM sentinel.
  • Reproduces at temperature=0 (greedy) → not a sampling artifact.
  • Intermittent and batch-composition dependent; severity scales with mixing very different sequence lengths in one batch.
  • Affects num_speculative_tokens 4 and 6 alike → not specific to the speculation depth.

Isolation (the key signal)

The exact same request that deterministically returns thoughtthought//thought… under --kv-cache-dtype auto returns the correct, coherent answer under --kv-cache-dtype fp8 — same weights, same greedy decode, only the KV dtype changed. A 1×(long) + 4×(short) concurrency battery is 0/5 garbage under fp8 and reliably corrupts the short requests under auto.

Repro

Server (clean):

vllm serve google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --max-model-len 262144 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser gemma4 --reasoning-parser gemma4 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","model":"google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized-assistant","num_speculative_tokens":4}'

Server (fails): identical, but --kv-cache-dtype auto.

Client (self-contained — builds the long context inline, no external data):

import concurrent.futures, openai
client = openai.OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1", api_key="x")

TOOLS = [{"type": "function", "function": {
    "name": f"tool_{i}", "description": f"Example tool {i}.",
    "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"arg": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["arg"]},
}} for i in range(12)]

# ~85k-token multi-turn context, generated inline:
LONG = [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a coding assistant."}]
for i in range(50):
    LONG.append({"role": "user", "content": f"Step {i}: " + "consider the following code and context. " * 80})
    LONG.append({"role": "assistant", "content": f"Step {i} done: " + "I reviewed and updated the implementation. " * 80})
SHORT = [{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2+2? Reply with just the number."}]

def ask(msgs):
    return client.chat.completions.create(
        model="gemma-4-31B", messages=msgs, tools=TOOLS, tool_choice="auto",
        max_tokens=24, temperature=0).choices[0].message

# Fire the long request together with several short ones, concurrently:
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as ex:
    futs = {"LONG": ex.submit(ask, LONG), **{f"short{k}": ex.submit(ask, SHORT) for k in range(4)}}
    for name, f in futs.items():
        m = f.result()
        print(name, repr(m.content), repr(getattr(m, "reasoning", None)))
  • Under fp8: every short* returns '4' and the long request is coherent (verified on our deployment with this exact script).
  • Under auto: the short* requests come back as thought-salad / cross-sequence bleed (samples below). It's intermittent/batch-composition dependent — run the batch a few times if the first happens to be clean.

Observed under auto — the SHORT requests, which should return "4", come back corrupted while batched with the long one:

reasoning='same same// umathoughtthought same//'   content=''                 # was "What is 2+2?"
reasoning='thoughtthoughtthought\thoughtthought'    content=' uma\n novellathought'
content='...<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{...'                                 # another request's tool schema leaking in

(These samples are from our live auto deployment — real ~64k coding sessions plus the same long+short concurrency pattern. We've since reverted production to fp8, so the minimal script above is verified clean on fp8; a maintainer on auto can confirm the garbage in one run.)

Not a transformers/model issue

Toggling only --kv-cache-dtype (auto↔fp8) on the same weights turns the bug on/off, so the model output itself is fine — the defect is in vLLM's non-fp8 KV-cache path under MTP speculative decoding (looks like batched spec-decode metadata / KV-slot misalignment across mixed-length sequences). The cross-sequence token bleed is also a correctness/isolation concern beyond output quality.

Before submitting a new issue...

  • Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the documentation page, which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
